cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the confident nod I taught you and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through our door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered measuring. Now remember my lesson about securing a bargain first. Nod; then we'll get the tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The driver is outside with his tape already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the quick nod we practised. If he asks about the door, I'll say you're handling it. Yes?

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies a real impending check rather than irrelevant pressure.

heightening.evidence: A5 accelerates the taught gesture and supplies a cover answer before scrutiny can occur.

specificity.evidence: A1 sofa acceptance and B2 doorway define practical consequence; B4 tape makes imminence concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final yes is direct; shifting questions to B adds pressure without lengthy explanation.
